'''Enemies Beta''' was active in all standard maps except [[Abyssal Trench]], [[Black Spot Exchange]], [[Candy Valley]], [[Chess Board]], [[Construction Crazy]], [[Cyber City]], [[Derelict Outpost]], [[Dusty Bridges]], [[Enchanted Forest]], [[Gilded Path]], [[Grass Isle]], [[Hot Spot]], [[Infernal Abyss]], [[Moon Base]], [[Musaceae Kingdom]], [[Nether]], [[Night Station]], [[Retro Zone]], [[Rocket Arena]], [[Ruby Escort]], [[Space City]], [[Sugar Rush (Map)|Sugar Rush]], [[Tropical Isles]], [[Winter Abyss]], [[Winter Stronghold]], [[Wrecked Battlefield]] and [[Wrecked Battlefield II]]. It was also active in all community and special maps. It was also active in the [[Classic Candy Cane Lane]], [[Classic Winter]], [[Classic Forest Camp]], [[Classic Island Chaos]] and [[Classic Castle]] event maps. By [[v2.0.0]], all of its effects (being displayed in the bottom left corner, altering enemy spawns and statistics, changing enemy appearance) either got removed or made impossible to see in-game through normal means. Therefore, while these maps may still have it, due to its lack of any visible changes or any way to easily prove its existence in a map, it is considered removed on the wiki. ==Effects== ===Enemy Appearances=== When active, '''Enemies Beta''' would change certain enemies to have different models and animations. These changes were only applied to legacy versions of these enemies. The following enemies received a new appearance if the modifier was active:
BetaNormal.png|[[Normal]] Speedbet.png|[[Speedy]] Slowbet.png|[[Slow]] NormalBossEnemiesBeta.png|[[Normal Boss]] BetaHidden.png|[[Hidden]] EnemiesBetaMystery.png|[[Mystery]]As '''Enemies Beta''' replaced the [[Mystery]] with the [[Breaker2]], it was not possible to see this appearance anymore in regular gameplay. Slowbossbet.png|[[Slow Boss]] BetaHiddenBoss.png|[[Hidden Boss]] SpeedyBossEnemiesBeta.png|[[Speedy Boss]] AbnormalBet.png|[[Abnormal]] QuickBeta.png|[[Quick]] Heavybet.png|[[Heavy]] Abnormalbossbet.png|[[Abnormal Boss]] Shadow3.png|[[Shadow]] Giantbossbetnew.png|[[Giant Boss]] ToshikazuHazamada.png|[[Hazard]] Tankbet.png|[[Tank]] Boomerbeta.png|[[Boomer (Legacy)|Boomer]]
===Wave Layout=== The wave layout on all maps with '''Enemies Beta''' active was changed to be as follows: *The [[Breaker2]] replaced the [[Mystery]]. **The [[Breaker2]] also spawned the [[Breaker]] upon death. *The [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]] replaced the [[Dark Necromancer]]. **The [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]] also spawned [[Skeleton]]s with its ''Summon'' ability. *The [[Breaker4]] replaced the [[Mystery Boss]]. **The [[Breaker4]] also spawned [[Breaker3]]s upon death. *The [[Warden (Legacy Enemy)|Warden]] replaced the [[Templar]]. *The [[Necromancer King]] replaced the [[Summoner Boss]]. **The [[Necromancer King]] also spawned [[Cursed Skeleton]]s with its ''Cursed Summon'' ability. ==Trivia== *When a legacy enemy with an '''Enemies Beta''' appearance spawned as a [[Boss]], it would always use its [[Enemies Beta]] appearance for the [[Boss]] health bar. **Because of this, it was possible to see every '''Enemies Beta''' model in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode if the player summons an enemy, like the [[Tank]], as a [[Boss]]. **This does not mean that the enemy itself would use that appearance, only the health bar would. **The [[Mystery]]'s '''Enemies Beta''' appearance could only be seen this way, as otherwise it gets replaced by the [[Breaker2]]. *As the [[Mystery]] was always replaced by the [[Breaker2]] with '''Enemies Beta''', it was impossible to see the full '''Enemies Beta''' appearance of the [[Mystery]]. **It was possible to see it in [[Polluted Wasteland II]] before the [[v1.4.2|Halloween 2022 Update]]. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''29 July 2022''' -
